finding.summary: `extractFormulaRanges` (highlighting) now receives REFERENCE tokens it cannot parse — the claimed "skips unbounded refs" behaviour is only in the docs
finding.evidence: docs/design/sheets/formula.md (new 'Limitations' paragraph) states "Whole-column/row highlighting (`extractFormulaRanges`) skips unbounded refs", but no change to `extractFormulaRanges` appears anywhere in the diff. Its implementation (packages/sheets/src/formula/formula.ts, documented as 'Each REFERENCE token is parsed into a Range') calls `parseRange`/`parseRef`, and `parseRef('A')` throws `Invalid Reference` (see the new `parsePartialRef` in packages/sheets/src/model/core/coordinates.ts, which exists precisely because `parseRef` cannot handle a column-only endpoint). Now that `A:A`/`1:1` lex as REFERENCE, typing `=SUM(A:A)` into the formula bar routes an unparsable token into the highlighter and can throw on every keystroke. Fix belongs in `extractFormulaRanges` (guard with `isUnboundedRange`) or its frontend caller.
